agent.description: the agent file, or a profile's name (configs/profiles/<name>.toml; default configs/default.toml)

budget.description: max_wall_seconds, max_cost_usd, max_model_calls per episode; max_total_cost_usd per suite

max_total_cost_usd.description: dollars for the whole run: no new episode once spent

max_wall_seconds.description: seconds per episode, checked before each model call

deploy.description: the deploy to resolve against (else --deploy or $HARNESS_DEPLOY)

endpoint.description: `harness program`: a worker that already runs

include.description: other files merged under this one, in order

layouts.description: one of procedural, eval: development or official evaluation layouts

model.description: the model roles: a name of configs/models/ (default the agent's)

overrides.description: [overrides.agent] and [overrides.model]: changes for this experiment only

agent.description: changes of the agent for this experiment

actions.description: direct mode: the action vocabulary, "module:function" (text, allow_policy, allow_skills) -> the program of one <action>; a ValueError names what is wrong with it

description.description: one line, shown by harness config and the run viewer

desktop.description: the agent on a computer (benches of embodiment kind desktop): roles, skills, services, runtime and budget keys merged over the ones above (runtime also over the model file's)

mode.description: program (default: the model writes programs) or direct (one action per call)

model.description: the default model roles: a model file's name (configs/models/<name>.toml), or the roles inline

none.description: the agent on no environment (benches of embodiment kind none): roles, skills, services, runtime and budget keys merged over the ones above (runtime also over the model file's)

prompt.description: the prompt: a pack directory (assembled for the enabled skills) or files, in order; or a table of them by embodiment kind (robot = ..., desktop = ...)

roles.description: the model roles the agent uses, among main, vlm, pointer, verifier (default all)

actions.description: written by the resolution: direct mode's action vocabulary (the agent's actions)

agent_skills.description: the app: Agent Skills the user installed, {name: {description, path}} (skills/agent_skills)

approvals.description: {ask, programs, rules} (runtime/safety/approval.py, permissions.py): ask = sensitive or programs (whether every program waits for the user); programs = the level of what a program does on the machine beyond its own folder (a command, the network, a file written elsewhere): never, ask_each, ask_once_session (default), allow; rules = [{level, action, match}] that win over it. Where nobody can be asked a level that asks refuses.

bootstrap.description: the kernel's session factory, "module:function" (default the program runtime's)

cameras.description: a standing watch declared by the configuration: these cameras' images reach the model with the opening message and after every program, as an evaluation's observation contract hands them to a policy. Without it the model gets text every turn and looks on its own demand (look, watch)

cell_timeout_seconds.description: optional deadline for a program, bounded by the episode deadline

clear_results_after_minutes.description: after this long without a reply of the model (the provider's cache of the conversation is cold), the results of all programs but the last 5 are cleared from the conversation (default 60; 0: never)

compact_at_tokens.description: compaction: when the context a call of the model read reaches this many tokens, the model writes a summary that replaces the conversation before its last messages (default 150000; 0: never)

contract.description: the observation contract (embodiments.contract_filter): native (default), xpolicylab (a robot's) or screenshot (a desktop's)

default_max_seconds.description: max_seconds of a bounded execution that names none

fixed_skills.description: direct mode: locate, pick and place in the action vocabulary

installed_skills.description: the app: the Harness skills the user installed, by name (the prompt's installed section, runtime/decision/prompts.py)

isolation.description: evaluation: run programs isolated, reaching only the installation, the source and the environment's services (true; "auto": with namespaces where the machine allows them). false: programs run on the machine as the user, under runtime.approvals. Experiments default to "auto"; a conversation a user starts is not isolated

keep_images.description: with runtime.cameras: images of the most recent turns kept in the history (default 2). Without it the model says how long a view stays (look(keep=), pin=)

knowledge.description: a game's knowledge: "learned" (default: use the agent's own library) or "handwritten" (allow reference knowledge). A worker that declares this setting must report the same mode.

label.description: a name the run viewer shows for the configuration

layers.description: written by the resolution from [skills] layers

library.description: what the agent learned: [runtime.library] path = ... (relative, or under $HARNESS_HOME/; layers = [...]). uses = "learn" (default: a run that learns counts its closed loops' results as uses of the library's entries, runtime/task/context.py), "on" (also with a frozen library: practice) or "off". Learning (runtime/learning/learner.py): learn = "off" (read a frozen snapshot, the experiment default) or "on" (keep proposals and enable verified entries at a safe boundary); trigger = "passive" or "active"; evidence = "test" (trusted verification) or "validated" (paired development scores); load = the minimum evidence to load (proposed, provisional, replayed, validated). Generated code always needs exact trusted proof. replay = true (recheck provisional entries at startup); reflect = true (propose from observed results at useful decision points). The active trigger's schedule (runtime/learning/active.py): active_before = true (before a task's runs, one run that learns its environment) and active_minutes = 1 to 240 (that run's live time, default 30)

longest_wait_seconds.description: the longest a <wait> of the model lasts, and what a wait without a time gets (default 60)

max_wait_seconds.description: accepted for older profiles. Use an explicit timeout to bound a program wait

mcp.description: written by the resolution: the MCP servers' client configs

mode.description: written by the resolution from the agent's mode

observer.description: explicit world observation: max_side (default 768), reasoning_effort (none), max_output_tokens (1200). Legacy timer settings are accepted for old profiles.

physical.description: the physical-input policy of this run over the user's settings (the computer package's harness_computer/physical.py): {level, rules}; harness run EXPERIMENT sets it from --physical, --allow-app, --deny-app, --ask-app

pointer.description: written by the resolution: the pointer role's client config

policies.description: written by the resolution: the learned policies' client configs

policy_progress_seconds.description: a run of a learned policy also ends when no object the last locate tracks has moved 3 cm for this many seconds, measured every half of it (default none: only when it stops)

post_policy_calls.description: with learned policies: model calls after the first run of a handed-over task, then the policy runs on to the end of the episode (0: it runs on at once; default none: no bound)

privacy.description: what the model learns of the user's windows in this run, over the user's settings (the computer package's harness_computer/privacy.py): {level, rules}; harness run EXPERIMENT sets the level from --window-details

reaction_delay_ms.description: time between an observation and the action decided on it, rounded up to whole control periods (runtime/tick.py): 0 (the default) for development and practice; 150-200 for a person's reaction time, as in a full game run or a recorded demo

reactive_budget_ms.description: total time for reactive callbacks on a control period (default 5 ms)

sandbox.description: written by `harness run` for an active run only: the bench's [sandbox] (runtime/learning/active.py), the practice sandbox its kernel gets; a task run never has one

search.description: the web search of search() (skills/web): {model, engine} on OpenRouter: a model id whose web plugin searches, and optionally the plugin's engine (exa, native, ...). None: search() says there is none

segmenter.description: written by the resolution: the segmenter's client config

skills.description: written by the resolution: the enabled skills

skills_dropped.description: written by the resolution: skills left out, and why

strategy_first.description: with learned policies: nothing moves before start(strategy, kind) (default false; the agent sets it)

strict_skills.description: a configuration built in code, without skills: fail instead of dropping a skill (resolve_for)

task_descriptions.description: a directory of task descriptions (<task>.md) added to the first message, or false

think_interval.description: accepted for older profiles. Decision scheduling is event-driven

think_while_acting.description: accepted for older profiles; it has no effect. Every program runs as a unit and the model's turn is its own while one runs

thinking.description: how long a call of the main model may think (runtime/conversation.py THINKING): model (the code's default: the model's own settings), none (reasoning off, replies of at most 2000 tokens, and the model is told to think briefly), low (reasoning effort at most low, 2000 tokens, told likewise), medium (at most medium, 8000 tokens) or high; a model set lower keeps its own. The agent thinks low on games

turn_grace_seconds.description: how long a program may hold the model's turn (default 2): one that is over by then gives the turn back with its result, a longer one goes on as a unit and the turn comes back with its handle

verifier.description: check success with the verifier before finishing (default true)

viewer.description: written by the session host: the model role that describes a view for a main model that reads no images (the setting model.vision); none: such a model is told the view was not sent

vision.description: written by the resolution: the vision service's client config

vlm.description: written by the resolution: the vlm role's client config

world_models.description: written by the resolution: the world models' client configs

services.description: segmenter, vision (the vision skill's generic perception), policies = [...], world_models = [...], mcp = [...] (MCP tool servers for the mcp skill): services the skills use

skills.description: layers = { learned, reactive, handlers }, or names = [...]; enable = [...] adds optional skills, disable = [...] removes skills

workspace.description: the agent on a project workspace (benches of embodiment kind workspace): roles, skills, services, runtime and budget keys merged over the ones above (runtime also over the model file's)

main.description: writes the programs (or, in direct mode, the actions)

agent.description: acp: the agent, acp:<id> as harness agents ls names it

api_key_env.description: the environment variable that holds the key (default OPENROUTER_API_KEY for openrouter)

backend.description: openrouter (default), openai_chat (any OpenAI-compatible server) or one a package provides (acp: an ACP agent answers as the model, the external-agents package)

base_url.description: openai_chat: the server's URL, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8800/v1

base_url_env.description: openai_chat: environment variable holding the server URL; overrides base_url when set

extra_body.description: extra request fields for OpenAI-compatible servers (e.g. max_image_side)

images.description: false for a model that reads no images: none is sent to it (default: it reads them)

max_output_tokens.description: tokens per reply, reasoning included on OpenRouter (default 8192)

max_tokens_key.description: the request field of that limit (default max_tokens; OpenAI's newer models take max_completion_tokens)

mode.description: acp: the agent's session mode (default: the first it offers that asks before it acts)

on_demand.description: written by the resolution for an on-demand service: the broker starts it first

reasoning_effort.description: the model provider’s reasoning option ID (effort_fields); omit to use its default

retry_seconds.description: keep retrying transient failures until this long after the request started

service.description: a service of the deploy instead of a hosted model: its client config, with this role's keys on top

session_meta.description: acp: fields added to the _meta of the agent's new sessions

stream.description: stream the reply: a dead connection shows within the read timeout while a model thinks
